notes:
Console 2.3.47. Print all now produces one PDF for the whole class.
- Print all as PDF: one file, one A4 page per learner, straight to the printer with no browser and no Word
- The PDF carries the school header, student details, A1-A3, formative and exam split, totals, grades, comments, initials and signature lines
- A subject nobody sat prints a dash in the PDF too, and comments and initials are never blank
- Word (.docx) is still there as a secondary button for schools that ask for it
